name: smwgraphics-hashire-hebereke-menu
title: Hashire Hebereke - Menu
description:
The background used in the menus from a very obscure foot-racer for the Super Famicom.

There are three palette choices, all from the original game: brown, green (default), and pink. A textless variant is also included which removes the hiragana characters in the background, and therefore, would be more useful.

Good for bonus levels.
